### ui/combobox.js
Custom `<select>` dropdown replacement for browsers whose native dropdown is
broken or unusable — the motivating case is Tesla's in-car browser, which
renders the native dropdown in a separate OS window the page never captures, so
the option list is invisible. Replaces a `<select>` with an in-page popup
listbox built from ordinary DOM and appended to `<body>`, so no native dropdown
is ever opened. The original `<select>` stays in the DOM as the model: it is
hidden but keeps its value, and choosing an option sets that value and
dispatches `input` + `change`, so any existing listener (or framework, e.g.
lil-gui) runs unchanged. Options are read live at open time, so a select whose
`<option>`s are repopulated later keeps working. Keyboard: arrows/Home/End move,
Enter/Space choose, Escape close, type-ahead. Rendered in the light DOM; injects
its own themeable stylesheet once. No dependencies.

Importing the module auto-registers `<combo-box>` (unless that tag is taken).

  import { installSelectFallback } from '.../ui/combobox.js';
  installSelectFallback();              // Tesla UA by default; { force: true } for any browser

  import '.../ui/combobox.js';          // registers <combo-box>
  //  <combo-box><select>…</select></combo-box>

Activation (installSelectFallback / shouldEnable): the UA gate matches Tesla by
default; override with `match: (ua) => boolean`, bypass with `force: true`, or
force at runtime via `?combobox=force`, `localStorage['js-combobox']='force'`,
or `globalThis.__JS_COMBOBOX_FORCE__ = true`.

Exports:
  installSelectFallback(opts?) → () => void
    Upgrade all current <select>s and (unless observe:false) watch for new ones
    via a MutationObserver. No-op unless shouldEnable(opts) passes. Returns a
    disposer that stops observing. Opts: force, match, root (ParentNode,
    default document), observe (default true), existingTrigger.
  upgradeSelect(select, opts?) → void
    Upgrade one <select>. Idempotent; skips multi-selects. opts.existingTrigger
    (select) => HTMLElement|null lets you reuse a host's own trigger that
    already paints the value (e.g. a lil-gui .widget whose .display stays in
    sync) instead of generating one.
  upgradeAll(root?, opts?) → void
    Upgrade every <select> under root (default document).
  openPopup(select, trigger, syncLabel?) → void
    Open the popup for a (hidden) select anchored to a trigger element.
  closePopup() → void
    Close the open popup, if any (one is open at a time).
  shouldEnable(opts?) → boolean
    Whether the fallback should activate (see Activation above).
  injectStyles() → void
    Inject the component stylesheet once (idempotent; no-op without a DOM).
    Called automatically by upgradeSelect.
  COMBOBOX_CSS: string
    The stylesheet source. Theme by overriding the --cb-* custom properties
    (--cb-bg, --cb-fg, --cb-border, --cb-accent, --cb-radius, --cb-popup-bg,
    --cb-popup-fg, --cb-popup-border, --cb-active).
  class ComboBox extends HTMLElement
    Backs <combo-box>; upgrades its child <select> on connect (no UA gate).
    Exported so you can register under another name.

Types: EnableOptions, UpgradeOptions, FallbackOptions.
